name: architecture-tradeoff-analysis
description: Systematic analysis of architecture trade-offs across classic dimensions (CAP theorem, PACELC, latency vs throughput, consistency vs availability, cost vs performance, coupling vs cohesion, flexibility vs simplicity, build vs buy). Per decision: options with attribute impact, prioritization of quality attributes for the use case, sensitivity analysis, and explicit trade-off acceptance. Simplified ATAM-style output. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
